description: Flat record-level metadata schema for soil samples from agricultural fields collected across locations and seasons and processed for metagenomic sequencing.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record. Use a stable alphanumeric ID.

field_id.descr: Identifier for the agricultural field or plot from which the sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Human-readable name of the sampling site or farm.

country.descr: Country where the soil sample was collected.

region.descr: Administrative region/state/province of the sampling location.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Sampling site elevation in meters above sea level.

sampling_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected.

sampling_time.descr: Time of day when the sample was collected, if available, in local time or ISO-8601 time string.

season.descr: Season at the time of sampling, for example spring, summer, autumn, winter, wet, or dry season.

crop_type.descr: Primary crop grown in the field at the time of sampling, if applicable.

land_use.descr: Agricultural land-use category, for example cropland, pasture, orchard, fallow, or mixed farming.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or texture category, if known, for example sandy loam, clay, or loam.

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval sampled from the soil surface in centimeters, reported as a single value or representative midpoint if a range was used.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for this sample within the study design.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as a percentage of wet mass or volumetric water content; specify the method in accompanying documentation if needed.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at the time of sampling in degrees Celsius.

air_temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius, if recorded.

precipitation_mm.descr: Recent precipitation amount associated with the sampling period, in millimeters, if available.

fertilizer_applied.descr: Indicates whether fertilizer had been applied to the field prior to sampling.

pesticide_applied.descr: Indicates whether pesticide or herbicide had been applied prior to sampling.

irrigated.descr: Indicates whether the field was irrigated around the time of sampling.

organic_management.descr: Indicates whether the field was managed under organic practices.

sample_collection_method.descr: Description of how the soil sample was collected, for example soil corer, auger, or composite sampling.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil collected for the sample in grams.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition after collection, for example on ice, refrigerated, frozen at -20 C, or frozen at -80 C.

storage_duration_h.descr: Time between collection and DNA/RNA extraction in hours, if known.

extraction_method.descr: Nucleic acid extraction protocol or kit used for the soil sample.

extraction_date.descr: Date when nucleic acid extraction was performed.

extract_concentration_ng_ul.descr: Measured nucleic acid extract concentration in ng/µL, if available.

extract_purity_ratio.descr: Nucleic acid purity metric such as A260/A280 ratio, if available.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used prior to sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument platform, for example Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, or Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used, for example shotgun metagenomics, amplicon sequencing, or hybrid approach.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs, if applicable.

paired_end.descr: Indicates whether sequencing was performed in paired-end mode.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate insert size of the sequencing library in base pairs, if available.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

metagenome_target.descr: Targeted metagenomic material, typically total community DNA from soil.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name or brief description of the primary bioinformatics pipeline used for downstream processing, if applicable.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional assignment, if applicable.

otu_asv_method.descr: Method used to infer features such as OTUs or ASVs, if applicable.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic classification, if applicable.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method used for functional annotation, if applicable.

quality_filtering_threshold.descr: Key sequence quality filtering threshold, for example minimum Phred score or percent identity, if applicable.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on any unusual sampling, environmental, or processing conditions relevant to this sample record.
